name: Integrated Solution Scoping Package
description: Ordered section list of the exported scoping package. The first twenty sections are the package contents required by the challenge specification (Functional Requirement 6); the final section carries the pre-export quality gate result.

sections.title: Executive summary
sections.source: executive_summary artifact (AI-generated, validated to cite only existing IDs)

sections.title: Customer objectives
sections.source: Scope model: BR business objective items, plus session customer context

sections.title: Requirement summary
sections.source: Scope model: approved items by type, priority and origin (customer-stated, AI-inferred, assumed)

sections.title: PRD
sections.source: prd artifact

sections.title: Functional scope
sections.source: functional_scope artifact: capabilities, modules, workstreams, delivery packages

sections.title: Solution architecture
sections.source: architecture artifact: components by area, with supported IDs, rationale, trade-offs and security considerations

sections.title: Architecture diagram
sections.source: package/diagrams.py: Mermaid generated from architecture components and flows; PNG embedded in DOCX and PDF exports

sections.title: Data strategy
sections.source: data_strategy artifact

sections.title: Integration architecture
sections.source: integration_architecture artifact, including the data and integration flow diagram

sections.title: AI solution approach
sections.source: ai_strategy artifact: use cases, processing classes, retrieval, evaluation, responsible AI and human review

sections.title: Recommended technologies and frameworks
sections.source: ai_strategy framework_recommendations and provider_options, resolved against seeds/catalogs/frameworks.json and the selected platform catalog

sections.title: Delivery phases and workstreams
sections.source: estimate_drivers artifact: phases, workstreams and milestones

sections.title: Effort and timeline estimate
sections.source: estimate artifact: effort and timeline ranges per workstream and phase, with the calculation trace

sections.title: ROM commercials
sections.source: estimate artifact: rate card, role mix, contingency and ROM range, with the calculation basis

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.source: Scope model ASM items with confirmation status, plus estimation assumptions from estimate_drivers

sections.title: Risks
sections.source: Scope model RISK items, plus delivery risks from estimate_drivers

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.source: Scope model DEP items, plus workstream and phase dependencies from estimate_drivers

sections.title: Open questions
sections.source: Scope model Q items with answer status, and GAP items that remain unresolved

sections.title: Requirement coverage
sections.source: traceability/coverage.py: coverage percentage, uncovered requirements and unsupported scope additions

sections.title: Traceability information
sections.source: traceability/index.py: requirement ID to artifact element matrix, with source references back to the customer text

sections.title: Quality gate results
sections.source: quality/service.py: results of every pre-export check, export status and items requiring human validation
